title: Smart Factory Virtual Commissioning Digital Twin (AML + Roles + Interfaces + URDF)
description: Multi-file IEC 62714 AutomationML smart-factory digital twin integrating an AGV material mover, 6-DOF robot workcell, optical quality station, and supervisory PLC with external RoleClassLib (roles.aml), InterfaceClassLib (interfaces.aml), and kinematic URDF model (robot_kinematics.urdf).
